fields.limitations: It cannot operate in temperatures outside -60°C to +50°C, wind speeds exceeding 30 m/s (approx 58 knots) for takeoff, or during severe flight control system failures.
It cannot operate in temperatures outside -55°C to +55°C, inside dense volcanic ash clouds, or under conditions causing severe engine compressor stalls.
It cannot operate in temperatures outside -55°C to +55°C, inside active microbursts, or during unmitigated fuel system ice blockages.
It cannot operate in temperatures outside -55°C to +50°C, with angles of attack (AOA) exceeding 26 degrees (unless overridden in emergencies), or inside heavy volcanic dust zones.
It cannot operate in crosswinds exceeding 30 knots, reverse on the ground if the aircraft weight exceeds specific tactical limits, or in severe freezing rain without active ice protection.
It cannot operate in severe icing conditions without active de-icing, in crosswinds exceeding 35 knots, or under structural loads exceeding maximum zero-fuel weight limits.
It cannot operate in moderate-to-severe icing conditions, wind speeds exceeding 45 knots for rotor startup, or in dense sandstorms that completely blind the radar and targeting arrays.
It cannot operate in temperatures outside -50°C to +45°C, with a crosswind component exceeding 15 knots for landing on contaminated surfaces, or inside heavy, unmonitored turbulence.
It cannot operate in severe icing conditions, with bank angles exceeding 45 degrees during flap deployment, or in high-density altitude environments under maximum cargo weight.
It cannot operate in severe icing conditions, with bank angles exceeding 60 degrees in the assault configuration, or during tailwind conditions that exceed maximum ramp door opening speeds.
It cannot operate in known icing conditions, with propeller RPMs sustained between 8,500 and 9,500 on the ground, or start engines with a tailwind exceeding 15 knots.
It cannot operate air-to-air refueling at altitudes below 2,000 metres or above 9,000 metres, in severe turbulence, or when fuel system transfer pump pressures drop below safe limits.

fields.limitations: It cannot operate with bank angles exceeding 30 degrees while the radar rotodome is active, in severe icing, or during critical electrical system overloads.
It cannot operate in severe icing conditions, in inverted flight for more than 30 seconds, or perform intentional spins with external fuel tanks or weapon stores fitted.
It cannot operate in icing conditions, perform more than two consecutive spin turns without recovery initiation, or in heavy turbulence with asymmetrical wing fuel loads.

fields.role: primary medium-lift workhorse (tactical airlift and logistics)
fields.limitations: It cannot operate in moderate icing without engine dust protectors removed, wind speeds exceeding 25 knots for rotor startup, or with tailwinds exceeding 15 knots during hover operations.
It cannot operate in known icing conditions, on slopes exceeding 7 degrees (nose up/down) or 10 degrees (lateral), or when ground resonance is encountered during touchdown.
It cannot operate in known icing conditions, on slopes exceeding 7 degrees, or perform high-rate aerobatic maneuvers with a full anti-tank guided missile payload.
It cannot operate in heavy icing, with payloads exceeding terrain-specific structural limits at the Siachen Glacier, or during active rotor stall conditions in high-temperature air layers.
It cannot operate with a tailwind exceeding 10 knots for engine start (or 25 knots for APU start), in known severe icing, or with mismatched engine torque deltas.

It cannot operate at night or in clouds without visual ground references (Day/Night VFR only), in heavy icing, temperatures outside -40°C to +50°C, altitudes above its 7,000-metre service ceiling, or during rotor startup/shutdown when wind speeds exceed 30 knots (with stricter limits for tailwinds and crosswinds).

It cannot operate in temperatures outside -40°C to +55°C, wind speeds with a headwind over 60 knots, crosswind over 30 knots, or tailwind over 25 knots during rotor startup/shutdown, heavy icing conditions, or altitudes above its 7,000-meter service ceiling.
It cannot operate in temperatures outside -40°C to +50°C, wind speeds exceeding 30 knots, heavy icing conditions, or altitudes above its 7,000-meter service ceiling.
It cannot operate in crosswinds or tailwinds above 20 knots, temperatures outside -50°C to +45°C, altitudes above 4,950 meters, or inside continuous heavy icing clouds.
It cannot operate in severe icing, winds exceeding 30 knots, temperatures outside -50°C to +37°C, or at altitudes above 5,400 meters.
